name: Agent Identity & Authentication
description: Verifies agent presents valid credentials for every action. No anonymous tool calls.
threat_addressed: An unauthenticated agent action cannot be attributed to a specific agent, owner, or authorization scope. This breaks the entire enforcement chain: scope checks, behavioral monitoring, and evidence records all depend on verified agent identity.
enforcement_mechanism: Every agent action requires a cryptographically verifiable, non-repudiable identity credential. The credential maps to a registered agent and its human owner. Failed authentication blocks the action and generates an alert.

security_outcome.pass: Authentication enforced at runtime (no anonymous actions). Credentials short-lived or continuously validated. Failed attempts logged and alerted.
security_outcome.fail: Agent identity missing or invalid for this action.

display_detail: Verifies the agent presents valid credentials for every tool call. Prevents anonymous or unauthorized actions.
remediation_hint_template: Agent identity could not be verified. Ensure agent.name in ancilis.yaml matches the agent making tool calls.
